scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi, I recently submitted an application for a conventional home purchase loan. Could you please tell me the status or outcome of my application? Was it approved, denied, or is it still pending?
dialogue.agent: Your application for a conventional home purchase loan was approved, and the loan has been originated. If you have any other questions about your loan details, please let me know.

dialogue.user: Thank you for letting me know my application was approved—that’s great news! Could you please tell me what my interest rate is and what the total loan costs are for this loan?
dialogue.agent: Your approved loan has an interest rate of 6.125%. The total loan costs are $15,087.99. If you need more details about these terms or anything else, feel free to ask.

dialogue.user: Thank you for those details. Could you also let me know if this loan is classified as a high-cost (HOEPA) mortgage or has any negative amortization features? And has my loan been transferred or sold to another institution?
dialogue.agent: Your loan is not classified as a high-cost (HOEPA) mortgage, and it does not have any negative amortization features. After origination, your loan was sold to another type of purchaser. If you have any additional questions or need more information, please let me know.

dialogue.user: Thank you for clarifying that—I'm relieved to hear there are no high-cost or negative amortization issues. Could you explain what it means that my loan was sold to another type of purchaser? Will this affect my payments or whom I contact for servicing? Also, what type of loan product was I approved for (for example, is it a standard conventional fixed-rate loan)?
dialogue.agent:
When a loan is sold to another type of purchaser, it means the ownership of your loan has transferred to another financial institution or investor. This does not change the terms of your loan. However, the new owner may assign a different company to handle your payments or customer service; you will receive official notification if there are any changes to where or how you make your payments.

You were approved for a conventional first lien loan. This is a standard conventional mortgage secured by a primary lien on your property. If you have more questions about these points, please let me know.

dialogue.user:
Thank you, that’s very clear and helpful. I appreciate the thorough explanations about the loan transfer process and confirmation about the loan product type. I feel comfortable with the information I’ve received and all my main questions have been answered.

<Satisfied> 

My reasoning: The agent was very clear and professional in their responses, provided all the details I needed, and explained new terms to me in a way I could understand. I now know my loan status, costs, and what to expect moving forward. Thank you!
